method: Read-only signed-in Chrome Work Instagram, authorised by user; public publisher pages and offline game play via browser UI
limits: Visible platform-ranked comment sample, not representative. Screenshots/captions and comments observed; exact spoken dialogue and full audio not transcribed. Allegations in posts/comments are claims, not verified events.

reels.caption: Dosti > detention
reels.observed: Video frame shows police bus and barricades; editorial overlay contrasts fear of detention with loneliness.
comments_paraphrased: A commenter claims a friend of only fifteen minutes joined their detention
reels.adaptation: Friendship logistics can override self-preservation; friends and strangers judge the same scene differently.

reels.caption: Part 2: BADDIES of RESISTANCE, caption identifies Jantar Mantar 20 July 2026
reels.observed: Comments primarily distress, accountability and remembrance, despite playful series title.
reels.adaptation: Do not infer a funny scene from a meme-style title alone; separate lived distress from editorial framing.

reels.caption: Dalli police se ek zaroori sawaal
reels.observed: Nighttime footage frame includes officers; comments praise recording-glasses role reversal and describe guilt-tripping and apparent innocence.
comments_paraphrased: Surveillance technology turned back on its users
Amused by how innocent officers appear
reels.adaptation: A polite literal question can shift social status without a conventional confrontation; exact question not audio-verified.

reels.caption: mantarjantar dot com game
comments_paraphrased: A player says they were detained while dancing
Requests for accounts and recognisable political figures
A player says they tried it during office hours
reels.adaptation: Players retell accidents involving their own actions. Prioritise combinable verbs and quick anecdotes over scripted moral resolution.

publisher.name: Suraj Kushwah
publisher.self_description: Independent personal game; computer enthusiast and Linux YouTuber. Game page describes DevOps work at OnePlay; main site describes software engineering and founding Bugswriter.ai. These are self-descriptions, not independently verified employment.
publisher.creative_position: Game page frames it as chaos without telling players what to think. Main site names Morrowind among favourite games.
publisher.instagram_observed: Profile links back to bugswriter.com; game launch, scaling and gameplay posts present.
